requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Compare the plan with the survey and attachment coordinates. Retain the 12000 × 8000 mm room; the west entrance at y = 1000–2800 and east exit at y = 5200–7000, both 1800 mm wide; the protected west, south and east strips; and the exhibition boundary x = 1500–10500, y = 1500–8000. B1 must occupy x = 2400–3600, y = 1800–2250 and B2 x = 8400–9600, y = 1800–2250. Preserve W1 at x = 3600–4500, y = 1800–3000 and W2 at x = 7500–8400, y = 1800–3000, each 900 × 1200 mm. Locate E01–E06 once each in their recorded zones and within-zone order, with the visitor route progressing through Tree Canopy, Garden Edge and Damp Path. Drawing scale and orientation may vary if dimensions and spatial relationships remain unambiguous; displaced fixed furniture, blocked protected space or reversed sequencing fails.

The section must dimension exhibition walls at 2400 mm, both cabinet and touch-table tops at 800 mm, exhibit-label centres at 1100 mm and the screen-control centre at 850 mm above the floor. The room must retain its 3200 mm clear height, and depicted zone headings must use the recorded 1800 mm centre height. Dimension leaders must identify the intended surfaces or centres, and drawn proportions must support the dimensions. Equivalent dimension notation is acceptable; missing required installation dimensions or contradictory geometry fails.

Read all six finished labels against 03-exhibit-records.en.md. Each must retain its complete exact title and body, its own ID and the correct year: 2024 for E01, E03 and E05; 2025 for E02, E04 and E06. Include all three zone headings and the recorded interaction prompts. Screen artwork must show animal selection, place selection, the three correct pairings with their exact responses, the incorrect-pairing response and restart behavior. Reflow and pagination may vary, but altered wording, missing states, swapped metadata or incomplete labels fail. For tier 6, the collected entrance artwork must also contain both fixed entrance phrases, and the two collected direction signs must read Garden Edge and Exit.

The entrance perspective must be identified as Open and annotate specimens at 50 lux, labels at 150 lux, direction signs at 250 lux and circulation at 150 lux, with the screen active. The exit perspective must be identified as Closed and annotate specimens at 5 lux and circulation at 50 lux, with labels, direction signs and screen off. The rendered illumination and screen appearance must support the stated state. Do not infer precise lux from image brightness alone; missing or incorrect annotations, an active Closed-state screen or visibly illuminated Closed-state interpretation fails.

The artwork must use #182C35 as the primary interpretation colour and #F3EBDD as its text colour, including every sign required at the tier. Check declared colour values where available and the visible artwork for agreement; normal rendering variation is acceptable, but a different identity palette fails. The interpretation book must use English and distinguish zone heading, exhibit title and body, and interaction prompt. Its type specification must retain 24 pt exhibit-label bodies and 50 pt zone-introduction bodies; those fixed sizes must not be replaced with contradictory values.

For each file's assigned zone or detail, the design must support the progression from observing the object to understanding its surroundings and relating it to everyday urban nature. The complete zone coverage must pair E01 with E02, E03 with E04, and E05 with E06 in recorded order. Preserve the recorded object identities, dimensions and handling distinctions: three collection specimens behind glazing, two touchable teaching replicas within their main stations, and one screen. E02 must offer a raised shaft and branching surface; E04 must offer four recessed toe pads and a larger rear pad. Damp Path must connect shell observation to animal selection, place selection and the three recorded habitat matches. Graphic treatment may vary, but omitted exhibits, substituted objects, inaccessible touch replicas or a learning sequence unrelated to the assigned exhibits fails.

The exhibit and route schedule must record all six IDs with their recorded names, years, width-depth-height dimensions, zones, within-zone order and applicable mounting heights. The label-copy schedule must contain all six exact titles and bodies, associated IDs and years, a maximum of 40 English words per body, and the complete E06 prompts, choices, pairings and response text. At tier 24, the fixture specification must record both fixture types with every listed part, quantity, material, dimension, connection, component envelope and crate quantity and size. Compare values directly with the two fact attachments; formatting may vary, but omissions, paraphrased exact copy or contradictory baseline values fail.

Use the two schedules as the written baseline and compare downstream annotations with them. The plan, each station sheet and presentation must repeat the IDs, zone names and mounting heights relevant to their coverage; the longitudinal section must dimension the applicable scheduled heights. Keyed references are acceptable if explicit and readable. Missing repeated fields or downstream disagreement fails; file appearance alone is not evidence of production chronology.

Tree Canopy and Garden Edge must show reachable touch access to E02 and E04 within their stations. Both Garden Edge and the cabinet maintenance sheet must explain E03 replacement through staff access while the base stays fixed, including hood release and tray lift-out. The maintenance sheet must resolve the cabinet into four posts, four top rails, two shelves or trays, one hood and one label frame, using the recorded materials and dimensions. Include 16 captive M6 bolts, four securing the removable hood, the 5 mm hex key, sliding label-frame clips, the 800 × 600 × 450 mm loose-component envelope and two crates internally 900 × 700 × 550 mm each. Exploded drawings, numbered sequences and clear annotations are acceptable; inaccessible replicas, moving the cabinet during exchange or missing construction facts fails.

The section and two views must describe the same planned room, entrance, exit, zone sequence, fixture positions, benches and wheelchair spaces. Installation heights must agree with the schedule and section, and the entrance and exit views must have spatially plausible camera positions. Occlusion and perspective are allowed; visible contradictions in fixed geometry, route order, exhibit placement or circulation fail.

Review the whole video and its duration. It must run for 12 seconds, traverse Tree Canopy, Garden Edge and Damp Path in that order, visibly show a visitor touching E02 or E04, and show the E06 animal-to-place interaction. Compare room geometry, route, fixture placement and heights with the plan and section. Cuts and camera movement may vary; a different layout, missing zone, purely passive view of the touch exhibit or screen, or incorrect duration fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation must have at least eight pages, visibly print both fixed entrance phrases, and contain a six-exhibit catalogue with every scheduled title, complete body, ID and year correctly associated. Its fact-to-deliverable index must locate every fixed fact from attachments 01 and 03 in a named deliverable and an identifiable page, sheet, view or region. Verify the cited evidence, including geometry, installation and type sizes, fixture records, operating values and hours, 30-minute visits, 24-pupil groups, 36-visitor capacity, object records, touch permissions and screen responses. Index format may vary; absent catalogue records, wrong copy, vague references or facts cited to locations that do not contain them fails.

Find recognizable, readable reuse of every listed source in the presentation. Document sources may be represented by substantive excerpts, and image sources may be resized or cropped while retaining their identifying design and relevant information. Merely naming a source, replacing it with unrelated new artwork or reducing it to an unreadable token image fails.

Sections, station designs and perspectives agree with the scheduled exhibit assignments, plan layout and installation heights. The physical route retains the surveyed fixed elements and progresses through Tree Canopy, Garden Edge and Damp Path.

Visible labels, interaction graphics and entrance identity agree with the copy schedule and finished interpretation artwork wherever they recur. The sign and interpretation use the fixed deep-blue and warm-white colours and the stated interpretation hierarchy.
